task:
Multiple assignment with set does not work when a target is a namespace attribute. This template fails to compile:

    {% set ns = namespace(a=12, b=36) %}{% set ns.a, ns.b = ns.a + 1, ns.b + 1 %}{{ ns.a }}|{{ ns.b }}

It must render 13|37, with trim_blocks and lstrip_blocks on as well as off. A single namespace attribute assignment, {% set ns.a = ... %}, and block assignment, {% set ns.a %}...{% endset %}, must keep working.

The safety check stays: assigning to an attribute of something that is not a namespace, alone or inside a multiple assignment, must still raise TemplateRuntimeError with the message "cannot assign attribute on non-namespace object". A dotted name outside a set target must still parse as normal attribute access.

Everything else must keep working.
accept: PYTHONPATH=src:.bench-deps python3 -m pytest -q -o addopts= -p no:cacheprovider tests
setup: python3 -m pip install -q --disable-pip-version-check --no-input --only-binary :all: --upgrade --target .bench-deps pytest==8.3.5 trio markupsafe
